description: Calculates the exact price for a silicone wristband configuration with the same calculation as the website and checkout (total, price per band, itemised fees, VAT or import charges for the delivery country) and returns the design link that opens the configurator on bandfactory.eu prefilled with this design for ordering.

band_pantone.description: Optional Pantone code for the band colour, e.g. 300 C.

country.description: Delivery country (ISO code). Prices include that country's VAT.

flag.description: Country or symbol flag printed next to the text (ISO code, pride or peace). Not together with symbol.

font.description: Font family. Some fonts are only available for the printed style.

quantity.description: Number of wristbands. Larger orders are quoted on request.

rainbow.description: Segmented rainbow band (6 colours) instead of one band colour.

repeat.description: How often text and symbol repeat around the band (default 1).

style.description: Finish: printed (flat, colour print), debossed_filled (engraved, colour-filled), debossed (engraved, no fill), embossed_printed (raised and printed), embossed (raised, no fill).

symbol.description: Icon in the text colour, e.g. heart, star, football. Not together with flag.

text_color.description: Colour of the outside text, symbol and fill, as hex.

text_color_inside.description: Colour of the inside text, as hex.

text_inside.description: Optional text on the inside of the band.

text_outside.description: Text on the outside of the band.

name: get_price_quote
title: Get price quote
